subject: math

objective.text: Use one pattern block to cover a half, a third, a fourth or a sixth of a shape.

source_ref.section: Lesson objective: Interpret equal shares in composite shapes as halves, thirds, and fourths.

explanations.title: One block covers a part
explanations.text: Find one block that covers part of a shape. If 2 of them cover it, each block is a half.

source_ref.section: Concept Development: note on covering a half, third or fourth

explanations.title: Fourths of a square
explanations.text: 4 small squares make 1 large square. Each small square is 1 fourth. 2 fourths is the same as 1 half.

explanations.title: Different pieces, same part
explanations.text: You can cover half a hexagon with 1 trapezoid or with 3 triangles. It is still half covered.

examples.title: Sixths of a hexagon
examples.text: 6 triangles cover the hexagon. Each triangle is 1 sixth of the hexagon.

questions.text: 158 is how many tens and 8 ones?

hints.text: Try each block. Which one fits 2 or 3 times exactly?
Look at the angles and sides. Which block matches part of the shape?
Count how many blocks cover the whole shape.
Shade one part at a time and count.
Draw a bar for the triangles and a bar for the squares.
Think of a hundred as bundles of ten.

assets_required.why_this_method: Blocks must have exact sizes so 2 trapezoids exactly cover a hexagon, 3 triangles a trapezoid, and so on.
assets_required.description: On-screen pattern blocks: hexagon, trapezoid, wide rhombus, triangle, square. The child drags blocks on top of a bigger shape to cover it.
must_show_exactly: All block sides the same unit length (trapezoid long side = 2 units)
states_or_frames: bottom half of hexagon covered by 3 triangles
assets_required.interaction: Drag, flip, slide and turn blocks; blocks snap to the outline.
assets_required.alt_text: Pattern blocks covering a bigger shape.
assets_required.generation_caption: Flat pattern block shapes in plain colours (hexagon, trapezoid, rhombus, triangle, square), white background. [Build by code]

assets_required.why_this_method: Exactly 4 equal small squares; shading count must match the question.
assets_required.description: A large square made of 4 equal small squares. Small squares can be shaded one at a time.
must_show_exactly: 4 equal small squares in a 2 by 2 grid
assets_required.interaction: Tap to shade a small square.
assets_required.alt_text: A square split into 4 small squares.
assets_required.generation_caption: Flat 2 by 2 grid of squares, white background, thin dark lines. [Build by code]
